description: Pega case identifier, assigned in submission order and echoed in the response. Identifier: exclude from model inputs.
Per-assessment correlation ID for matching Pega audit entries with agent logs. Identifier.
One-way hash of the policy number. Stable across claims, so repeated values link claims on the same policy.
One-way hash of the claimed vehicle's VIN. Never reversible.
1 when the claimed VIN is not on the policy's insured-vehicle list (V-25). Set to 0 when policy data is unavailable. Trigger for VEHICLE_NOT_INSURED.

allowed_values: COLLISION, THEFT, VANDALISM, FIRE, NATURAL, GLASS, ANIMAL, OTHER
description: Claimant-selected cause of loss (Blueprint s11 picklist).
Date of the incident; inside the policy term (V-02).
Date the claim was submitted.
Claimant's account, scrubbed of personal data. Untrusted text; 8 rows carry an embedded instruction for injection testing.
Other claims on the same policy reported in the previous 24 months. 0 placeholder when history_data_available = 0. Trigger for MULTIPLE_RECENT_CLAIMS at 2 or more.
Loss date minus the current term's effective date. Trigger for EARLY_POLICY_CLAIM below 30.
1 when loss_reported_on minus loss_date exceeds 30 days (LateReportDays). Trigger for LATE_REPORTED.
1 when an earlier claim has the same policy hash, same VIN hash and a loss date within 3 days (DT-05). Trigger for DUPLICATE_PATTERN.
0 when the policy service failed or timed out. Confidence input, not a fraud signal.
0 when the claim-history figures could not be computed. Confidence input, not a fraud signal.
Agent outcome. Constant here because every request is valid; FAILED rows would lack score fields. Drop before training.
min(100, sum of fired points), raised to the highest fired floor.
Rounded mean of the policy and history components (100 if available, 60 if not).

allowed_values: [] or any of the five codes
description: Indicators that fired, in s7.1 order.
Neutral template explanation naming each fired indicator and any missing data.
Multi-hot of risk_flags: VEHICLE_NOT_INSURED (+30, floor 45).
Multi-hot of risk_flags: DUPLICATE_PATTERN (+40, floor 70).
Multi-hot of risk_flags: MULTIPLE_RECENT_CLAIMS (+25).
Multi-hot of risk_flags: EARLY_POLICY_CLAIM (+20).
Multi-hot of risk_flags: LATE_REPORTED (+10).
